train_autoencoder: train a PyTorch autoencoder using an experiment config file with multi-GPU support and resume capability
resume_training: resume autoencoder training from a saved checkpoint by passing the --resume flag to train.py
import_module_dynamic: dynamically import a Python file as a module using importlib with a custom module name
create_logger: create a Logger instance that duplicates stdout to a log file and tracks iteration numbers
run_training_with_profile: run the training script with a specific config profile and custom devices using argparse arguments
